historical.function/_immutable_goal_id:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pgjobdb._immutable_goal_id()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.goal_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.goal_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'primary goal is immutable' USING ERRCODE='JGF01'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

historical.function/_archive_goal_identity:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pgjobdb._archive_goal_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 SELECT goal_id INTO NEW.goal_id FROM pgjobdb.jobs WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND job_id=NEW.job_id;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

retained.function/_immutable_retained_goal:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pgjobdb._immutable_retained_goal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF (NEW.goal_origin,NEW.goal_created_at,NEW.record_kind,NEW.terminal_failure,NEW.cell_id,NEW.cell_repo)
  IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.goal_origin,OLD.goal_created_at,OLD.record_kind,OLD.terminal_failure,OLD.cell_id,OLD.cell_repo)
  OR (OLD.goal_closed_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.goal_closed_at,NEW.goal_success_job_id,NEW.historical_goal_success)
   IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.goal_closed_at,OLD.goal_success_job_id,OLD.historical_goal_success)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'retained goal identity or first closure is immutable' USING ERRCODE='JGF01';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
